==English==

===Etymology===
From {{uder|en|fr|classifier}}. {{surf|en|class|-ify}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈklæs.ɪ.faɪ/|a=UK}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-classify.wav|a=Southern England}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈklæs.əˌfaɪ/|a=US}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# to [[identify]] by or [[divide]] into [[class]]es; to [[categorize]]
#: {{ux|en|Should we '''classify''' "make up" as an [[idiom]] or as a [[phrasal]] [[verb]]?}}
# to [[declare]] something a [[secret]], especially a [[government]] secret
#: {{ux|en|They decided to '''classify''' that information.}}
# To make [[classy]]

====Synonyms====
* See also [[Thesaurus:classify]]

====Antonyms====
* {{antsense|to declare a secret}} {{l|en|declassify}}

====Derived terms====
